mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate at its current level (0.14%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) over the entire sample period.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in instances where UNRATE > 8.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) and low residential fixed investment (RSAFS < 380000) indicates a dual stress on labor and demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in instances where UNRATE > 8.5% AND RSAFS < 380000.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles, indicated by FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, increase discount rates and reduce equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) at 223.49 compresses real interest rates, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) over the entire sample period.

mechanism_narrative: Weak industrial production (INDPRO < 94) signals a slowing economy, reducing corporate earnings growth and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in instances where INDPRO < 94.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5%) and low housing starts (HOUST < 500) indicates a deteriorating economic environment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in instances where UNRATE > 8.5% AND HOUST < 500.

mechanism_narrative: A demand recovery phase, indicated by rising residential fixed investment (RSAFS > 370000) and rising housing starts (HOUST > 500), signals improving consumer demand and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in instances where RSAFS > 370000 AND HOUST > 500.
